subject: Evaluation ramp & commercial handoff — MAP, credits, and conversion path
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@tracklytics.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com; ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ava.bennett@tracklytics.com
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: evaluation scope + what we need to get to commercial

Hi Rachel / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the LATENCY profile you showed on long sessions is promising. We want to formalize a short mutual action plan so our internal stakeholders (product ops, procurement) can evaluate and sign off. High-level asks from our side: 

- A 6-week evaluation window with a soft SLA for response/uptime for critical tests
- Pilot credits to cover ~1.5M tokens for model-led scenarios (ingestion + production-like prompts)
- A clear conversion path outlining pricing by commit tiers and any ramp discounts if we hit usage thresholds
- An outline of deliverables from Redwood (support hours, onboarding checkpoints, playbook)

Can you propose a draft MAP and an initial commercial anchor (list price and a tranche discount table)? Also confirm what procurement needs to see (PO terms, SOC2 evidence, IP addenda).

We’re targeting an internal decision by the week of May 24; ideally a PO in early June if the pilot meets our perf targets.

—Jordan
Jordan Miles
Head of ML Platforms, Tracklytics
From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@tracklytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evaluation scope + what we need to get to commercial

Hi Jordan — great to line this up. Attached is a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) and a simple pricing grid (Pricing_Grid_Tracklytics.xlsx). Key points from our side: 

- Evaluation window: 6 weeks, starting on the date of the sandbox entitlement. We’ll extend the sandbox by 7 days at no charge if you need extra test time to reproduce edge cases.
- Pilot credits: We can provide 1.25M tokens of pilot credit up front and a second tranche of 500k contingent on completion of milestone 2 (500k tokens used + performance signoff). Total potential credits = 1.75M.
- Conversion pricing: base list at $0.015/token for embeddings, $0.025/token for generation (small-batch profile). We propose a 15% volume discount at a committed monthly spend of $25k and a 25% discount at $75k/month. We also include a one-time ramp discount (10%) for the first 3 months after conversion to help offset integration costs.
- Support & onboarding: two 4-hr enablement sessions, weekly sync during the first month, and two emergency on-call windows during the pilot.

Procurement checklist we’ve seen requests for: standard PO, SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, and a short SOW for the onboarding scope. I’ve attached a PO template for your procurement team to review.

If this looks good, Ben (cc’d) will coordinate the commercial redlines and Neha can confirm the SOC2 + security artifacts. I’ll stand up the sandbox access once we approve the MAP milestone dates.

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) Week 0: Sandbox entitlement + baseline perf test (deliverables: sandbox access, initial perf run)
2) Week 2–3: End-to-end scenario run (deliverables: 500k token run, perf report, regressions) — triggers additional 500k credit tranche
3) Week 4–6: Scale stress + production mimic (deliverables: 1M token cumulative, latency/throughput review) — decision point for commercial conversion

Let me know if you want to swap any milestone order or adjust token tranches.

Thanks — I’ll be available tomorrow afternoon for a short sync if helpful.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@tracklytics.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-12T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evaluation scope + what we need to get to commercial

Jordan — thanks for the quick review. A couple of clarifications on the commercial anchor: 

- We can tighten the conversion pricing if Tracklytics is willing to commit to a 12-month minimum spend. With a 12-mo commit we’ll move the 15% tier to 20% and the 25% tier to 35%.
- The ramp discount (10% for first 3 months) will be applied as a bill credit after the first invoice, not as a permanent list change.
- For procurement, our legal team prefers PO + countersigned SOW rather than heavy redlines on our master services agreement to keep timelines tight. We can share a redline window next week (legal@redwoodinference.com).

Neha — can you confirm SOC2 delivery timeline and whether we can provide our pen-test summary?

Jordan — if that 12-month commit sounds reasonable, we can put a simpler contract together and offer an additional $10k onboarding credit (applied to the first invoice) in exchange for an early-sign commitment by June 10. That credit is additive to the pilot credits noted in Rachel’s MAP.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@tracklytics.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com; rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ava.bennett@tracklytics.com
Date: 2027-05-22T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evaluation scope + what we need to get to commercial

Thanks — this is helpful and gets us close. Quick responses: 

- The MAP as outlined is fine, we’d like the milestone language tightened (we’ll send a one-page acceptance checklist) but the token tranches look reasonable.
- The 12-month commit + improved discount cadence is acceptable to our finance team. We’ll aim to lock to the middle tier (target ~$45k/month) with a 25% discount in the contracting dialogue.
- The extra $10k onboarding credit and the 7-day sandbox extension are appreciated — can you add the onboarding credit to the SOW and note the sandbox extension in the MAP appendix?
- Procurement asked for one more week of trial capacity (an operational ask): would Redwood top up an additional 250k pilot tokens if we confirm by EOD Friday? That will let us finish a final performance sweep before the decision window.

If you can confirm the additional 250k token top-up + that the onboarding credit will be included in the SOW, we’ll mark this MAP as accepted on Tracklytics’ side and route a PO (PO template attached) to your legal/procurement team. We’ll also start the DocuSign flow referenced in your related links.

Appreciate the speed here — we should have an internal approval by May 26.

Jordan
Head of ML Platforms, Tracklytics
